title: Check if a string is a palindrome
hint: Walk two pointers inward from both ends and compare characters as you go.
interviewFollowUp: How would you adapt this to ignore case and non-alphanumeric characters, like "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"?

title: Check if two strings are anagrams of each other
hint: Two strings are anagrams if every character appears the same number of times in both — count with an array or map instead of sorting if you want O(n).
complexity: Time: O(n), Space: O(1) — fixed 26-slot array
interviewFollowUp: How would this change if the input could contain Unicode characters instead of just lowercase a-z?

title: Find the first non-repeating character in a string
hint: Count every character's frequency first, then scan the string again in order and return the first one with count 1.
interviewFollowUp: Could you solve this in a single pass instead of two, and is it worth the added complexity?

title: Find the longest substring without repeating characters
hint: Sliding window: expand the right edge, and when you hit a repeat, jump the left edge past its last occurrence.
complexity: Time: O(n), Space: O(min(n, charset size))
interviewFollowUp: How would you return the actual substring, not just its length?

title: Implement basic string compression
hint: Walk the string once, counting consecutive repeats of the current character, and flush a run whenever the character changes.
complexity: Time: O(n), Space: O(n) for the output
interviewFollowUp: What should happen if the compressed string ends up longer than the original — should the function return the original instead?
